name: Lee
source:
Lee is a scary-faced writer who's actually really embarrassed that he loves romance novels and wants to start writing his own, but actually has no idea where to start. He'd never admit to the ungodly amount of time he's spent lurking in the romance aisle to no avail.

He thinks himself beyond hope, but the heroine won't leave a fellow romance lover behind!

[From [url=http://somethingventuredgames.tumblr.com/post/153415095402/more-fools-helper-is-a-slice-of-life]Something Ventured Games[/url]]
